//lastChange: Page model for the website builder (2026-09-08). services/website/pages.js derives the whole site map from the pharmacy row and its profile: the router will serve from it, the sitemap will be generated from it, and every title, breadcrumb and internal link comes out of it. One function decides what exists, which is what makes a sitemap listing a 404, or a page nothing links to, structurally impossible rather than merely unlikely. Pages are derived and never stored, so adding a service to the profile creates its page and removing it takes the page away with nothing to publish or tidy. A page is only created when the pharmacy has the information it would be about — a generated page with nothing real on it is a thin page, and a site full of them ranks worse than a small site that is entirely substantial.
